rows.label: qst104217_msg0001
rows.name: Heheheh... The power of science!

rows.label: qst104217_msg0002
rows.name:
Are you interested in
Kyukyu's research, mo?

rows.label: qst104217_msg0003
rows.name:
I crush, mix, and burn ores and herbs
to see how they react, mo.

rows.label: qst104217_msg0004
rows.name:
I put my brain to work fine-tuning
proportions and figuring out
combinations, mo.

rows.label: qst104217_msg0005
rows.name:
I keep at it believing that someday
I'll make something shiny and golden,
or a medicine that cures anything, mo.

rows.label: qst104217_msg0006
rows.name:
I used to be in Acedia, but my lab,
tools, and money are all gone, mo.

rows.label: qst104217_msg0007
rows.name:
I have no choice but to continue
my research here, but...

rows.label: qst104217_msg0008
rows.name:
I need more research funds, mo...
I want to do my research inside
a building, mo...

rows.label: qst104217_msg0009
rows.name:
I want to keep researching while
earning money at a job that uses
my knowledge and skills, mo...

rows.label: qst104217_msg0010
rows.name:
Are you looking for a teacher
in Iyasaki Village, mo?

rows.label: qst104217_msg0011
rows.name:
If I can do it alongside my research,
I don't mind. Are you sure you want
Kyukyu, mo?

rows.label: qst104217_msg0051
rows.name: Invite Kyukyu to be a teacher?

rows.label: qst104217_msg0052
rows.name: Invite

rows.label: qst104217_msg0053
rows.name: Think it over

rows.label: qst104217_msg0061
rows.name: Understood, mo.

rows.label: qst104217_msg0062
rows.name:
I don't have much luggage, so
I can get ready quickly, but...

rows.label: qst104217_msg0063
rows.name:
I don't have money, so I'll take cheap
Divine Beast ships and make my way
there slowly, mo.

rows.label: qst104217_msg0081
rows.name:
If you change your mind,
let me know, mo.

rows.label: qst104217_msg0101
rows.name: Heheheh... The power of science!

rows.label: qst104217_msg0102
rows.name:
Is this an invitation to teach, mo?
I'd be half researcher, half teacher.
Is that okay, mo?

rows.label: qst104217_msg0151
rows.name: Heheheh... The power of science!

rows.label: qst104217_msg0152
rows.name:
I'm running out of money to buy
materials to burn, mo... I have no
choice but to work, mo...

rows.label: qst104217_msg201
rows.name:
Kyukyu crushes, mixes, and
burns ores and herbs to
experiment on their reactions, mo.
